title: Another Wolf Story
author: James Baldwin
summary: 农夫们循着狼的脚印追踪，决定第二天全村出动猎狼。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1912 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: Three farmers were walking across a field and looking eagerly for tracks in the soft ground. One carried a gun, one had a pitchfork, and the third had an ax.
paragraphs.zh: 三个农夫走过一片田野，急切地在松软的地上寻找脚印。一个扛着枪，一个拿着干草叉，第三个拿着斧头。

paragraphs.en: "Wolf! Wolf! Wolf!" they cried, as they met another farmer coming over the hill.
paragraphs.zh: “狼！狼！狼！”他们遇见了另一个从山那边走来的农夫，便喊道。

paragraphs.en: "We don't know," was the answer, "but we saw her tracks down there by the brook. It's the same old wolf that has been skulking around here all winter."
paragraphs.zh: “我们不知道，”他们回答，“但我们看见她的脚印了，就在下面的小溪边。就是整个冬天一直在这附近鬼鬼祟祟的那只老狼。”

paragraphs.en: "She killed three of my lambs last night," said the one whose name was David Brown.
paragraphs.zh: “她昨晚咬死了我三只羊羔。”一个叫戴维·布朗的人说。

paragraphs.en: "She's killed as many as twenty since the winter began," said Thomas Tanner.
paragraphs.zh: “入冬以来，她咬死的羊差不多有二十只了。”托马斯·坦纳说。

paragraphs.en: "How do you know that it is only one beast that does all this mischief?" asked the fourth farmer, whose name was Israel Putnam.
paragraphs.zh: “你怎么知道干这些坏事的只有一只野兽？”第四个农夫问，他叫伊斯雷尔·普特南。

paragraphs.en: "Because the tracks are always the same," answered David Brown. "They show that three toes have been lost from the left forefoot."
paragraphs.zh: “因为脚印总是一样的，”戴维·布朗回答，“脚印显示，她左前脚少了三个脚趾。”

paragraphs.en: "She's been caught in a trap some time, I guess," said Putnam.
paragraphs.zh: “我猜她什么时候被夹子夹住过。”普特南说。

paragraphs.en: "Samuel Stark saw her the other morning," said Tanner. "He says she was a monster; and she was running straight toward the hills with a little lamb in her mouth. They say she has a family of young wolves up there; and that is why she kills so many lambs."
paragraphs.zh: “塞缪尔·斯塔克前几天早上看见她了，”坦纳说，“他说那是个庞然大物，她嘴里叼着一只小羊羔，径直往山里跑。据说她在山上有一窝小狼，所以她才会咬死这么多羊羔。”

paragraphs.en: "Here are the tracks again," said Putnam.
They could be seen very plainly, for here the ground was quite muddy. The four men followed them for some distance, and then lost them on the hillside.
paragraphs.zh: 脚印看得非常清楚，因为这里的泥地很湿。四个人跟着脚印走了一段路，最后在山坡上跟丢了。

paragraphs.en: "Let us call the neighbors together and have a grand wolf hunt tomorrow," said Putnam. "We must put an end to this killing of lambs."
paragraphs.zh: “我们明天把邻居们都召集起来，来一场大规模的猎狼吧，”普特南说，“必须制止这种咬死羊羔的事。”

paragraphs.en: All the other men agreed to this, and they parted.
paragraphs.zh: 其他人都同意了，于是大家分头散去。
